scope: P01-P08 systemic visual-polish and carry-over requalification rules
reason: P01 exposed two distinct failure classes: first, visually generic native text / over-regularized modules; second, a later REWORK improved identity anchors while preserving several structurally valid FIRST BUILD assets whose older design language remained visible in CURRENT. Layer cleanliness alone did not prevent visual carry-over debt.

fixedShortDisplayTextPolicy.rule: Short fixed display text may be image-generated or prepared display art when its visual treatment is part of the page identity. This permission is not limited to personal names.
fixedShortDisplayTextPolicy.sourceOfTruthRule: When the visible display is generated/prepared art, retain the approved exact string separately as native/source-of-truth data and QA the visible rendering against it.
preferNativeWhen: precision metadata where styling is not identity-critical
hardRejects: choosing generic native type solely because it is easier to edit
baking long or frequently changing copy into raster art
treating generated visible text as the authoritative factual source

editorialIrregularityPolicy.principle: Preserve authored local irregularity from the Visual Master; do not manufacture random messiness and do not normalize the page into UI components.
rules: Do not force equal heights, equal photo sizes, equal padding or equal icon alignment merely for component reuse.
When the Visual Master contains measured differences, preserve them or tune toward them during Reference Delta.
Do not assign arbitrary rotation formulas or random offsets. Any tilt/offset must serve the Visual Master or improve direct visual comparison.
Related modules may share publication DNA without sharing identical geometry.
hardRejects: randomized scrapbook rotation with no reference basis

tactilePrintFinishPolicy.principle: Use restrained tactile/print character to avoid flat digital/AI-sticker appearance, but never apply indiscriminate global grain.
allowedCharacteristics: subtle paper fiber or matte print feel
small local imperfections that support the visual master
avoidOn: real photographs unless part of an approved photo treatment
the entire page as a uniform noise overlay unless the Visual Master explicitly requires it
hardRejects: texture added merely to make output look less digital
visible compression/noise mistaken for tactile print quality
tactilePrintFinishPolicy.qa: Texture/material treatment must survive A5 readability and Reference Delta; if it becomes the first thing noticed, it is too strong.

visualCarryOverPolicy.principle: A clean Figma layer tree can still contain visually stale production assets. Existing assets receive no grandfathered visual approval merely because they were previously ADOPTED, technically valid, or unchanged in a newer build.

coreDistinctions.layerCleanliness: No hidden/rejected/stale nodes remain in LIVE Figma.
coreDistinctions.assetFreshness: Every visible inherited asset still matches the current Visual Master and current page quality bar.
coreDistinctions.pageCoherence: New and inherited assets read as one authored design language rather than different production eras mixed together.

triggers: a REWORK/CURRENT promotion reuses any production asset from an earlier build
a high-saliency identity anchor or Hero is regenerated/replaced
the page quality bar materially increases after owner feedback
a previously weak area is fixed while neighboring assets are left unchanged
the user reports that old parts still look visible even when stale-layer scan passes
visualCarryOverPolicy.mandatoryAuditScope: Audit every visible inherited production asset, not only files whose node names contain OLD/FIRST/V20. Provenance and appearance both matter.
auditViews: A5-size thumbnail when the asset affects readability or rhythm

statuses.UNREVIEWED_CARRYOVER: Inherited visible asset has not yet been requalified against the current Visual Master/current quality bar.
statuses.KEEP_REQUALIFIED: Inherited asset was explicitly rechecked in the current composition and still fits both Visual Master and current design language.
statuses.REWORK_REQUIRED: Asset job remains valid but its current visual execution is weaker/staler than the current page.
statuses.REPLACE_REQUIRED: Asset's visual concept/job no longer fits and should be rebuilt/replaced rather than patched.
statuses.SUPERSEDED: Asset has been removed from CURRENT and retained only as history/QA evidence.

requiredAuditFieldsPerInheritedAsset: coherence with newly improved neighboring assets
visualCarryOverPolicy.adjacencyRequalificationRule: When a high-saliency anchor/Hero is materially improved, automatically reopen nearby supporting assets for requalification. Improving a title can make an old ribbon, ticket, feature vessel or badge visibly obsolete even if that asset did not itself regress.
visualCarryOverPolicy.maintainedDefinition: MAINTAINED is allowed only after explicit current-build requalification. 'Unchanged since first build' is not evidence. 'No regression' is insufficient if the asset remains materially behind the Visual Master or newly raised surrounding quality bar.

coherenceGate.question: Does the page look like one authored magazine cover/page, or like new identity anchors placed on top of older UI-like production parts?
failExamples: new expressive masthead + old generic feature-card vessels
new premium display lettering + old flat/cheap ticket or badge
new people-led Hero + support modules whose scale/material/rhythm still belong to the previous draft
mixed outline/shadow/material systems that reveal different production eras

visualCarryOverPolicy.promotionRule: A candidate may become the best CURRENT working version while carry-over debt remains, but it must be labeled PROMOTED_CURRENT_WITH_CARRYOVER_DEBT and cannot claim final REFERENCE_DELTA_PASS / FIGMA_DESIGN_COMPLETE until all material inherited assets are KEEP_REQUALIFIED, REWORKED, REPLACED or explicitly user-deferred.
hardRejects: treating ADOPTED as permanent visual approval
passing carry-over because node names are clean
keeping an old asset only because generation effort was already spent
marking an inherited asset PASS/MAINTAINED without explicit current-build comparison
allowing new and old design languages to coexist because the page is technically layered/editable

feedbackDebtPolicy.rule: A newly discovered systemic failure pattern reopens FEEDBACK_DEBT even if the previous feedback cycle was closed. Closing one debt does not freeze future acceptance rules.
feedbackDebtPolicy.currentP01Lesson: P01 REWORK improved major anchors and was a valid better CURRENT, but the later visual carry-over review found inherited FIRST BUILD vessels/ticket/story assets still visible. Therefore page promotion and page completion must be treated as separate decisions.
feedbackDebtPolicy.blockScalingRule: Do not scale a production method to later pages while a newly discovered systemic carry-over failure remains unmodeled or unaudited.

acceptanceRule: These policies are evaluated during docs/rurubu-v30/FIGMA-EXECUTION-ACCEPTANCE.md. Structural QA, stale-layer scans, prior ADOPTED status, or a locally improved REWORK cannot waive visual carry-over/coherence review.
